# Test that cmd/go adds the "tsan" tool tag when -fsanitize=thread is present
# in CC, CGO_CPPFLAGS, or CGO_CFLAGS, and that runtime/cgo selects C files
# under msan and tsan even when GOEXPERIMENT=runtimecgopurego is enabled.

env GOOS=linux
env GOARCH=amd64
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env GOEXPERIMENT=runtimecgopurego
env CC=
env CGO_CPPFLAGS=
env CGO_CFLAGS=

# Default: no tsan tag, pure-Go runtime/cgo (no C files).
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
! stdout '\btsan\b'
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout '^\[\]$'

# CGO_CFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread enables tsan tag and selects C runtime/cgo files.
env CGO_CFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
stdout '\btsan\b'
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout 'gcc_libinit_unix.c'

# Comma-separated sanitizer list containing thread.
env CGO_CFLAGS='-O2 -fsanitize=undefined,thread'
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
stdout '\btsan\b'
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout 'gcc_libinit_unix.c'

# Later -fno-sanitize=thread disables tsan tag.
env CGO_CFLAGS='-fsanitize=thread -fno-sanitize=thread'
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
! stdout '\btsan\b'
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout '^\[\]$'

# Later -fno-sanitize=all disables tsan tag.
env CGO_CFLAGS='-fsanitize=thread -fno-sanitize=all'
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
! stdout '\btsan\b'

# Later -fsanitize=thread re-enables tsan tag.
env CGO_CFLAGS='-fno-sanitize=thread -fsanitize=thread'
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
stdout '\btsan\b'

# Non-thread sanitizer does not set tsan tag.
env CGO_CFLAGS=-fsanitize=address
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
! stdout '\btsan\b'

# CGO_CPPFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread enables tsan tag.
env CGO_CFLAGS=
env CGO_CPPFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
stdout '\btsan\b'
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout 'gcc_libinit_unix.c'

# CGO_CFLAGS=-fno-sanitize=thread overrides CGO_CPPFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread.
env CGO_CFLAGS=-fno-sanitize=thread
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
! stdout '\btsan\b'

# CC with -fsanitize=thread enables tsan tag.
env CGO_CPPFLAGS=
env CGO_CFLAGS=
env CC='clang -fsanitize=thread'
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
stdout '\btsan\b'
go list -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout 'gcc_libinit_unix.c'

# CGO_CFLAGS=-fno-sanitize=thread overrides CC with -fsanitize=thread.
env CGO_CFLAGS=-fno-sanitize=thread
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
! stdout '\btsan\b'

# CGO_ENABLED=0 does not set tsan tag.
env CC=
env CGO_CFLAGS=-fsanitize=thread
env CGO_ENABLED=0
go list -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
! stdout '\btsan\b'

# -msan selects C runtime/cgo files.
env CGO_ENABLED=1
env CGO_CFLAGS=
go list -msan -f '{{context.ToolTags}}'
stdout '\bmsan\b'
go list -msan -f '{{.CFiles}}' runtime/cgo
stdout 'gcc_libinit_unix.c'

-- go.mod --
module m

-- p.go --
package p
